items.stem: Which mechanism authorizes what an authenticated subject may do in a Kubernetes cluster?

options.rationale: Correct: RBAC binds subjects to roles that grant specific permissions.
Readiness probes signal traffic-readiness, not authorization.
ResourceQuota limits resource usage, not permitted actions.
Autoscalers adjust replica counts, not authorization.
